maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue: A pale shimmer gathers in the empty hall, flickering uncertainly before taking the shape of a robed figure.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-10: No trap. No mechanism. Nothing hidden.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-12: You sense no soul or living presence within the figure.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-13: Whatever stands before you is only an echo.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-15: You reach out. Your hand passes straight through the figure.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-16: The image flickers, then reforms as if nothing happened.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-18: The image flickers once more. Then the wizard turns his gaze toward you.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-19: When he speaks, his voice rolls through the hall like words preserved in stone.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-2: The translucent apparition steadies, then slowly raises its head toward you.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-22: "WHATEVER PURPOSE BROUGHT YOU HERE, NONE MAY STAND BEFORE ME UNTESTED."
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-23: "THE PATH AHEAD WILL TEST MORE THAN STRENGTH. JUDGMENT. WILL. INTENT."
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-24: "ENDURE THE TRIALS, AND YOU SHALL HAVE YOUR AUDIENCE."
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-25: The apparition falls silent for a moment.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-26: "FAIL... AND YOU WILL NOT LEAVE THESE HALLS."
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-27: The wizard's image fractures into pale light and vanishes.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-28: The doors slam shut behind you and the chamber sinks into unnatural gloom. You can barely see a few steps ahead.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-29: But you are not alone. Something moves in the darkness. You feel its presence circling closer, waiting to tear into you.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-30: Light floods the chamber, driving the unnatural gloom into the corners.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-31: A terrible shriek tears through the room. For a heartbeat, something twists within the fading darkness. It is vulnerable now!
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-7: You reach into the spell, searching for its source.
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-8: "An illusion... its source runs through the tower itself."
maps.points.tower_level1.dialogue-9: You inspect the floor, walls, and surrounding stone.
maps.points.tower_level1.title: Projection of the high tower
